note: Cities with a page, by Census place GEOID (state FIPS + place code). Each row was read by hand on the city's own site on the day `read` names; only https links to the city's own pages, never a page for one parcel. A city needs a `permits` and a `zoning` row. `county` is the county the city's page sits under (most of the city is in it; `other_counties` says parts of the city are in other counties). `built` and `value` are the Census's medians for the city, filled by build-data.cjs.

sources.homes: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates, tables B25035 (median year structure built) and B25077 (median value, owner-occupied housing units), place geography

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Altamonte Springs, Building and Fire Safety Department
rows.line: Licensed contractors obtain specific permits, check permit status and schedule inspections through the Civic Access portal; permits online are limited to those needing no plan review or attached to a building permit already reviewed and issued.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Altamonte Springs?
rows.a: In Altamonte Springs, permits and inspections are handled by the City's Building and Fire Safety Department. Licensed contractors can obtain specific permits, check their status and schedule inspections through the Civic Access portal, limited to permits that need no plan review or belong to a building permit already reviewed and issued.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Altamonte Springs, Planning and Development Division
rows.line: Administers the City's Land Development Code and implements City Plan 2030, the comprehensive plan; rezonings, conditional uses and variances need a pre-application conference with division staff.
rows.q: Where is Altamonte Springs' zoning?
rows.a: The City of Altamonte Springs' Planning and Development Division administers the City's Land Development Code and implements City Plan 2030, its comprehensive plan. Rezonings, conditional uses and variances require a pre-application conference with division staff.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Aventura, Building Division
rows.line: Issues building permits for new construction and renovations, reviewing applications for compliance with zoning codes and the Florida Building Code; inspections by qualified, licensed inspectors are required.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Aventura?
rows.a: The City of Aventura's Building Division issues building permits for new construction and renovations, reviewing applications for compliance with zoning codes and the Florida Building Code. Inspections by qualified, licensed inspectors are required, and the City notes it is against state law to do business with an unlicensed contractor.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Aventura, Planning and Zoning Division
rows.line: Interprets land use regulations for City staff and landowners, maintains development records and plans, and issues recommendations on development petitions; the page links the Comprehensive Plan and the Future Land Use Map.
rows.q: Where is Aventura's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Aventura's Planning and Zoning Division interprets land use regulations for City staff and landowners, maintains development records and plans, and issues recommendations on requests for development petitions. Its page links the Comprehensive Plan and the Future Land Use Map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Coral Gables Development Services, Building Division
rows.line: The Building Division is in charge of the permitting process and the Florida Building Code related plan review and inspections; permits are applied for, searched and paid for by category from this page.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Coral Gables?
rows.a: The City of Coral Gables' Building Division, in the Development Services Department, is in charge of the permitting process and the Florida Building Code related plan review and inspections. The Development Services page lets people apply, search and pay for permits by category, and schedule and check inspections.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Coral Gables Development Services, Planning & Zoning Division
rows.line: The City's Zoning Code, an interactive 3D Zoning Map and a Parcel Zoning Check that looks up zoning and property data, on a platform the City launched with Gridics, LLC.
rows.q: Where is Coral Gables' zoning?
rows.a: The City of Coral Gables, in conjunction with Gridics, LLC, launched a zoning code and map platform holding the City's Zoning Code, an interactive 3D Zoning Map and a Parcel Zoning Check to look up zoning and property data. The map combines zoning district designations, future land use classifications and other data layers.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Town of Cutler Bay Community Development, Building Division
rows.line: Assures compliance with the Florida Building Code: building plan review, building permits, inspections during construction and Certificates of Occupancy; a permit is required to construct, enlarge, alter, repair, move or demolish a building or structure.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Cutler Bay?
rows.a: The Town of Cutler Bay's Building Division assures compliance with the Florida Building Code, which regulates all building construction activities within the Town; its services include building plan review, the issuance of building permits, inspections during construction and the issuance of Certificates of Occupancy. A permit is required to construct, enlarge, alter, repair, move, demolish or change the occupancy of a building or structure, or to install, alter, repair or replace an electrical, gas, mechanical or plumbing system.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: Town of Cutler Bay Community Development, Planning & Zoning Division
rows.line: Provides zoning plan review, zoning information and interpretations and administers the Town's Growth Management Plan and Land Development Regulations; the page links the Interactive Zoning Map.
rows.q: Where is Cutler Bay's zoning?
rows.a: The Town of Cutler Bay's Planning and Zoning Division provides zoning plan review, zoning information and interpretations, and administers the Town's Growth Management Plan and Land Development Regulations, which list the Town's land use and development requirements, including density, permitted uses, building setbacks and signage. Its page links the Interactive Zoning Map and the Zoning and Land Development Regulations.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Doral, Building Department
rows.line: Its page links applying for a permit, inspections, fees and forms; the Florida Building Code Ninth (2026) Edition takes effect December 31, 2026, and permit applications submitted on or after that date must comply with it.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Doral?
rows.a: The City of Doral's Building Department takes permit applications and lists its inspections, fees and forms. All permit applications and plans submitted on or after December 31, 2026 must comply with the Florida Building Code Ninth (2026) Edition.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Doral, Planning and Zoning Department
rows.line: Gives guidance on zoning regulations, land use and development standards; its services include zoning code interpretation, development review and site plan approval, and variances and zoning applications.
rows.q: Where is Doral's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Doral's Planning and Zoning Department guides growth and development in the city and gives guidance on zoning regulations, land use and development standards. Its services include zoning regulations and code interpretation, development review and site plan approval, and variances and zoning applications.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Gainesville Building Division
rows.line: Takes permit applications online through PermitGNV, by email, by mail or in person; its PermitGNV portal also shows existing permits.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Gainesville?
rows.a: The City of Gainesville's Building Division issues building permits. Applications go in online through PermitGNV, by email, by mail or in person, and the PermitGNV portal also shows existing permits.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Gainesville Planning Division
rows.line: Holds each development to the city's Comprehensive Plan and Land Development Regulations; a Planner of the Day answers planning questions.
rows.q: Where is Gainesville's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Gainesville's Planning Division applies the city's Comprehensive Plan and Land Development Regulations to each development, and its Planner of the Day answers planning questions.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Hialeah, Building Department
rows.line: Enforces the Florida Building Code and Miami-Dade County regulations: reviews permit applications, issues permits, inspects, issues certificates of completion and occupancy, keeps records of building plans and manages flood and elevation certificates.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Hialeah?
rows.a: The City of Hialeah's Building Department reviews building permit applications, issues permits and conducts inspections under the Florida Building Code and Miami-Dade County regulations. It also keeps records of building plans and blueprints and manages flood and elevation certificates.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Hialeah, Planning and Zoning Division
rows.line: Zoning regulations, including zoning maps, land use designations and rules on permitted uses and building dimensions, govern land use; the division handles variances, rezoning and special use permits, and a Zoning Verification Letter confirms information about a specific property.
rows.q: Where is Hialeah's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Hialeah's Planning and Zoning Division sets the zoning regulations that govern land use, including zoning maps, land use designations and rules on permitted uses and building dimensions. It manages requests for variances, rezoning and special use permits, and a Zoning Verification Letter confirms information about a specific property.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Homestead, Building Department
rows.line: Enforces State of Florida, Miami-Dade County and City codes for building construction, alteration and maintenance; it reviews plans, issues permits and certificates of occupancy and completion, and conducts inspections.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Homestead?
rows.a: The City of Homestead's Building Department enforces the codes of the State of Florida, Miami-Dade County and the City for the construction, alteration and maintenance of buildings. It reviews plans, issues permits and certificates of occupancy and completion, and conducts inspections; plan review status and inspection results can be checked online.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Homestead, Planning and Zoning Division
rows.line: Maintains the Comprehensive Plan and Zoning Code and reviews plans for new development and redevelopment; these documents regulate variances, development approvals, certificates of use, site plans, special exceptions and zoning standards.
rows.q: Where is Homestead's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Homestead's Planning and Zoning Division maintains the Comprehensive Plan and Zoning Code and reviews plans for new development and redevelopment for compliance. Those documents regulate variances, development approval procedures, certificates of use, land use criteria, site plan requirements, special exceptions and zoning standards.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Kissimmee Building Division, Permits & Inspections
rows.line: Most home projects still need a permit under Florida's rules that took effect July 1, 2026, and the City must be told first even when one isn't needed; the Building Division works under the Florida Building Code.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Kissimmee?
rows.a: The City of Kissimmee's Building Division issues building permits under the Florida Building Code. Under Florida's rules that took effect July 1, 2026, most home projects still need a permit, and the City must be told first even when one isn't needed.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Kissimmee, Planning & Zoning
rows.line: Finds a property's zoning category online; the Development Code sets the use and design rules, and use and plan reviews are applied for here.
rows.q: Where is Kissimmee's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Kissimmee's Planning & Zoning pages find a property's zoning category online. The city's Development Code sets the use and design rules for development, and use and plan reviews are applied for there.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Miami, Permits & Construction
rows.line: Permits go through the City's digital systems, iBuild and ePlan; its pages also search a property's permit history and schedule inspections.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Miami?
rows.a: The City of Miami issues building permits through its digital permitting systems, iBuild and ePlan. Its Permits & Construction pages also search a property's permit history and schedule building inspections.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Miami Office of Zoning
rows.line: Interprets and administers the Miami 21 Zoning Ordinance; its pages find a property's zoning category and issue zoning verification letters and waivers.
rows.q: Where is Miami's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Miami's Office of Zoning interprets and administers the city's zoning ordinance, Miami 21. Its pages find a property's zoning category and handle zoning verification letters, waivers and special permits.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Miami Beach, Building Department
rows.line: Supervises and regulates construction under the Florida Building Code and the City's Code of Ordinances; its page covers the permitting process, permitting checklists, applying for a permit, inspections and building recertification.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Miami Beach?
rows.a: The City of Miami Beach's Building Department regulates construction under the Florida Building Code and the City's Code of Ordinances. Its page covers the permitting process, permitting checklists, applying for a permit, inspections and building recertification.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Miami Beach, Planning Department
rows.line: Prepares, administers and maintains the City's comprehensive plans and the Land Development Regulations of the City Code, which the page calls the zoning code; the page links administrative zoning interpretations and the City's maps and guidelines.
rows.q: Where is Miami Beach's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Miami Beach's Planning Department prepares, administers and maintains the City's comprehensive plans and the Land Development Regulations of the City Code, its zoning code. Its page links the regulations, administrative zoning interpretations and the City's maps and guidelines.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Miami Gardens, Building Services Department
rows.line: A one-stop shop for construction and development, with Building, Engineering, and Business Licensing and Housing Compliance divisions, enforcing the Florida Building Code and other rules on construction and land use.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Miami Gardens?
rows.a: The City of Miami Gardens' Building Services Department is a one-stop shop for construction and development in the city, enforcing the Florida Building Code and other regulations on construction and land use. It includes the Building, Engineering, and Business Licensing and Housing Compliance divisions.

rows.title: Zoning

rows.line: The Zoning and Land Development Code is chapter 34 of the City's Code of Ordinances; a pre-application is required for all new development or redevelopment.
rows.q: Where is Miami Gardens' zoning?
rows.a: Miami Gardens' Zoning and Land Development Code is chapter 34 of the City's Code of Ordinances. A pre-application with the Planning and Zoning Department is required for all new development or redevelopment in the city.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of North Miami Building Department
rows.line: Enforces the Florida Building Code, accessibility codes and flood management measures through the permit and inspection process, inspecting building, roofing, electrical, mechanical, structural and plumbing work.

rows.a: The City of North Miami's Building Department enforces the Florida Building Code, accessibility codes, flood management measures and related standards through the permit and inspection process. Its inspections verify compliance in building, roofing, electrical, mechanical, structural and plumbing work, and it also does re-occupancy inspections and 30-year recertification.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of North Miami Community Planning and Development, Zoning Section

rows.a: The City of North Miami's Zoning Section, in the Community Planning and Development Department, gives technical and professional recommendations to the public to ensure compliance with the Land Development Regulations and the Comprehensive Plan, and oversees existing development and redevelopment within City limits. Chapter 29 of the City of North Miami Code of Ordinance is available on Gridics.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of North Miami Beach Building Department
rows.line: Accepts building permit applications, issues all building and trade permits and verifies compliance with the Florida Building Code; its officials inspect new and existing structures.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in North Miami Beach?
rows.a: The City of North Miami Beach's Building Department accepts building permit applications, issues all building and trade permits and verifies compliance with the Florida Building Code. Its building, plumbing, electrical and mechanical officials inspect new and existing structures for compliance.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of North Miami Beach Planning and Zoning Division
rows.line: Links the Official Zoning Map, the Zoning and Land Development Code and an interactive GIS zoning map that finds a property's zoning district by address.
rows.q: Where is North Miami Beach's zoning?
rows.a: The City of North Miami Beach's Planning and Zoning Division links the Official Zoning Map and the Zoning and Land Development Code, and an interactive GIS zoning map finds a property's zoning district by address.

rows.title: Building permits

rows.line: Permits are applied for through the Accela Citizen Application, where an account brings real-time updates; Florida's CS/CS/HB 803, effective July 1, 2026, adds two building permit exemptions for single-family residences.

rows.a: The City of North Port takes permit applications through the Accela Citizen Application, an online portal where contractors, residents and businesses create an account, apply for permits and get real-time updates from Development Services. Since July 1, 2026, a state law, CS/CS/HB 803, gives single-family residences two new building permit exemptions.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of North Port Development Services, Planning and Zoning Division
rows.line: Handles current and long-range planning, review and permitting of land development for compliance with the Unified Land Development Code; its office is on the first floor of City Hall.
rows.q: Where is North Port's zoning?
rows.a: The City of North Port's Planning and Zoning Division handles planning, review and permitting of land development for compliance with the Unified Land Development Code. Its page links the City Code, City Charter and ULDC, the Comprehensive Plan and the City's map portal.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Sanford Development Services, Building Division
rows.line: Issues building permits, performs field inspections and issues certificates of occupancy under the Florida Building Code; all building permitting is on the Citizenserve online portal, where permit status, fees and inspections are handled.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Sanford?
rows.a: The City of Sanford's Building Division issues building permits, performs field inspections and issues certificates of occupancy, enforcing the Florida Building Code, State Statutes and City Ordinances. All building permitting is on its Citizenserve online portal, where people can check permit status, pay fees and schedule inspections.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Sanford Development Services, Planning Division
rows.line: Reviews zoning and subdivision applications and maintains the Comprehensive Plan, the Zoning Ordinances and the maps that set the rules for land use and development.
rows.q: Where is Sanford's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Sanford's Planning Division reviews zoning and subdivision applications and oversees applications for discretionary permits. It maintains the Comprehensive Plan, Zoning Ordinances and maps that provide the policy and regulatory bases for land use and development.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Sarasota Development Services, Building & Permitting
rows.line: Reviews building plans and inspects every building project in the City for code compliance; permits are submitted and inspections requested online.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Sarasota?
rows.a: The City of Sarasota's Building & Permitting division reviews building plans and inspects every building project in the City. Permits are submitted and inspections requested online.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Sarasota Planning Department
rows.line: Its Long-Range Planning Division keeps the Sarasota City Plan, the comprehensive plan, and the City Zoning Code.
rows.q: Where is Sarasota's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Sarasota's Planning Department keeps the City Zoning Code; its Long-Range Planning Division develops and maintains the code and the Sarasota City Plan.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Sunny Isles Beach Building Department
rows.line: Issues building permits for new construction and renovations, reviewing applications for compliance with zoning codes and the Florida Building Code; the process is fully digital, with every application submitted online through a portal account.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Sunny Isles Beach?
rows.a: The City of Sunny Isles Beach's Building Department issues building permits for new construction and renovations, reviewing applications for compliance with zoning codes, the Florida Building Code and other regulatory agencies. Its permit process is fully digital: all permit applications are submitted online through a portal account, which covers plan review, comments, permit issuance, inspections and permit closeout.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Sunny Isles Beach Planning and Zoning Department
rows.line: Offers zoning plan review and administers the Land Development Regulations, which implement the City's Comprehensive Plan; it also reviews all building permits submitted to the Building Department.
rows.q: Where is Sunny Isles Beach's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Sunny Isles Beach's Planning and Zoning Department offers zoning plan review and uses comprehensive planning, site planning and zoning regulations, known as the Land Development Regulations, which implement the City's Comprehensive Plan. It advertises zoning public hearings for site plan review, conditional uses, variances and zoning changes, and reviews all building permits submitted to the Building Department.

rows.title: Building permits

rows.line: Issues every building permit and inspection for development inside the city.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Tampa?
rows.a: The City of Tampa's Construction Services Division reviews plans, issues building permits and inspects construction for property inside the city.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Tampa, Zoning Maps
rows.line: An interactive map of zoning districts inside the city limits; the zoning code is Chapter 27 of the city code.
rows.q: Where is Tampa's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Tampa's zoning maps show the zoning district of each property inside the city limits, by address. The zoning code itself is Chapter 27 of the City of Tampa Code.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Venice Building and Code Enforcement Department
rows.line: Provides permitting and inspections for residents, contractors and developers; permit information, inspection scheduling and fee payment are on the City's Online Permitting service, and the Building Department no longer accepts paper permit applications.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Venice?
rows.a: The City of Venice's Building and Code Enforcement Department provides permitting and inspection services to residents, contractors and developers. Permits are applied for through the City's Online Permitting service, which also handles inspection scheduling and fee payment, and the Building Department no longer accepts paper permit applications. A permit becomes invalid unless the work it authorizes starts within six months of issuance.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Venice Planning & Zoning Department
rows.line: Implements the Land Development Code and the City's Comprehensive Plan, adopted January 12, 2018; an interactive map searches the Zoning or Future Land Use designation of any property in the City.
rows.q: Where is Venice's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Venice's Planning & Zoning Department guides growth and development through the Land Development Code, the review of development projects and the City's Comprehensive Plan, updated in 2017 and adopted on January 12, 2018. Its interactive map searches the Zoning or Future Land Use designation of any property in the City of Venice.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Winter Springs Community Development, Building Division
rows.line: Reviews plans, issues building permits and performs inspections for code compliance; the page links the City's Civic Access Portal and the building permit application.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Winter Springs?
rows.a: The City of Winter Springs' Building Division enforces federal, state and local codes governing construction: its staff reviews plans, issues building permits and performs inspections. Its page links the City's Civic Access Portal and the building permit application.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Winter Springs, Planning & Zoning
rows.line: Handles development applications, zoning verification letter requests, variance and waiver applications and rezoning requests; the City's Zoning Ordinance is on Municode.
rows.q: Where is Winter Springs' zoning?
rows.a: In Winter Springs, zoning divides real property into districts with uniform development regulations such as allowed uses, height limitations, building setbacks and lot size, and the City's Zoning Ordinance is on Municode. The Planning and Zoning division handles zoning verification letter requests, variance and waiver applications and rezoning requests.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Village of Arlington Heights, Building and Life Safety Department
rows.line: Permits go through the Village's Civic Access Portal, where submitters track their permit in real time, schedule inspections, upload documents and communicate with staff.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Arlington Heights?
rows.a: The Village of Arlington Heights' Building and Life Safety Department takes permits through its Civic Access Portal, where submitters can track a permit in real time, schedule inspections, upload documents and communicate with staff.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: Village of Arlington Heights, Planning and Community Development
rows.line: Provides planning, zoning, subdivision and design services and reviews proposed land uses and development projects; its page links the Zoning Code and the Zoning Map.
rows.q: Where is Arlington Heights' zoning?
rows.a: The Village of Arlington Heights' Planning and Community Development Department provides planning, zoning, subdivision and design services and reviews proposed land uses and development projects. Its page links the Village's Zoning Code and Zoning Map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Chicago Department of Buildings, Permits
rows.line: A permit is required before most construction, demolition and repair work; the Department's Guide to Permits covers small and mid-sized projects for homeowners.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Chicago?
rows.a: The City of Chicago's Department of Buildings issues building permits; one is required before most construction, demolition and repair work. Its Guide to Permits covers small and mid-sized projects for homeowners, and its site checks a permit application's status.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Chicago Department of Planning and Development, Zoning Ordinance Administration
rows.line: Reviews building permit applications for compliance with the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, with plan examiners at City Hall.
rows.q: Where is Chicago's zoning?
rows.a: The Zoning Ordinance Administration Division of Chicago's Department of Planning and Development reviews building permit applications for compliance with the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, with plan examiners at City Hall.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Town of Cicero Building Department
rows.line: A completed permit application, available at the Building Department, is reviewed for compliance with building codes, zoning ordinances and town ordinances; once it is approved and all necessary fees are paid, the Building Commissioner issues the permit.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Cicero?
rows.a: In the Town of Cicero, permit applications are available at the Town of Cicero Building Department. A completed application is reviewed for compliance with building codes, zoning ordinances and town ordinances; once it is approved, and after all necessary fees are paid, the Building Commissioner issues the permit. Each construction phase is inspected by a Town of Cicero Building Inspector.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: Town of Cicero Legal Department
rows.line: Handles Town zoning information requests, zoning appeals and applications for rezoning, special permits and variances; the page links the Town Zoning Map.
rows.q: Where is Cicero's zoning?
rows.a: The Town of Cicero's Legal Department handles Town zoning information requests, zoning appeals, and applications for rezoning, special permits and variances, including fence variance requests. Its page links the Town Zoning Map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Des Plaines Community and Economic Development, Building and Permits

rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Des Plaines?
rows.a: The City of Des Plaines requires permits for certain construction projects and conducts building permit and code enforcement inspections. On December 15, 2025, the City Council adopted the 2021 I-Codes, including the International Residential Code, and the 2020 National Electric Code.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Des Plaines Community and Economic Development, Planning and Zoning
rows.line: Zoning sets the areas where different types of buildings are allowed, from houses and apartments to businesses, factories and schools; the page has sections on what a lot is zoned, what can be done on it and which regulations apply.
rows.q: Where is Des Plaines' zoning?
rows.a: In Des Plaines, zoning sets the areas where different types of buildings are allowed, such as houses, apartments, businesses, factories and schools. The City's Planning and Zoning page has sections on what a lot is zoned, what can be done on it and which regulations apply, and it takes zoning questions by email.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Evanston Community Development, Building and Development Services

rows.a: The City of Evanston's Building and Development Services Division, in the Community Development Department, handles construction permitting, building inspections and property maintenance code enforcement. Its permit desk takes walk-ins Tuesday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to noon.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Evanston Community Development, Planning and Zoning
rows.line: Administers the Zoning Ordinance, Title 6 of the Evanston City Code, processes applications for zoning relief such as variations, and reviews building applications for construction permits for compliance.
rows.q: Where is Evanston's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Evanston's Planning and Zoning Division administers the Zoning Ordinance, Title 6 of the Evanston City Code. It reviews proposals and applications for compliance, processes applications for zoning relief such as variations, and provides zoning information on properties in the city.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Village of Glenview Community Development, Development Center
rows.line: Takes permit applications online or in person, issues simple permits over the counter and small and medium-sized ones through same-day review; in a code update for January 1, 2027 the Village is adopting the 2024 International Construction Codes.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Glenview?
rows.a: The Village of Glenview's Development Center, just inside Village Hall, is the first point of contact for building permits: applications are submitted online or in person, simple permits are issued over the counter, and small and medium-sized permits can be obtained through same-day review. rows.office: Village of Glenview Community Development, Planning Division

rows.q: Where is Glenview's zoning?
rows.a: The Village of Glenview's Planning Division processes petitions for annexations, rezoning, site plan reviews, subdivisions, variations and conditional use permits. The Land Use Table within the Municipal Code identifies which uses are permitted in the Village's zoning districts, and the Planning Division's page links the Zoning District Map and an interactive zoning map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Village of Hoffman Estates Development Services Department
rows.line: Permits are applied for, checked and paid on the BS&A Online Permit Portal, where inspections are also scheduled, online by 3:00 PM the day before; the page has permit handouts for residential projects from decks and fences to roofs and water heaters.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Hoffman Estates?
rows.a: The Village of Hoffman Estates takes building permit applications on its BS&A Online Permit Portal, where residents and contractors also check permit status, pay and schedule inspections; all inspection requests must be submitted online by 3:00 PM the day before the desired date. Its Unified Development Ordinance establishes the standards for zoning districts, site design, land use and building requirements.

rows.office: City of Edmond, Residential Building Permits
rows.line: Sorts home projects into the City's permit types: a new house, townhouse or duplex, an accessory building of 200 square feet or more, an alteration, or an addition.

rows.office: City of Edmond, Zoning

rows.office: City of Midwest City, Permits and Inspections
rows.line: Residential and commercial permit applications go through the CityWorks public access portal; the plan reviewer checks construction codes, zoning and City ordinances, and a residential permit is typically reviewed within 3 to 5 days.

rows.a: In Midwest City, completed permit applications and plans go to the Engineering and Construction Services Department, and the CityWorks portal takes residential and commercial permit submissions online. rows.line: Manages how land is used and developed: zoning controls what types of development are allowed in specific areas, and the team reviews applications for rezoning, minor variances and special permits.

rows.a: Midwest City's Planning and Zoning component of the Community Development department manages how land in the city is used and developed. Zoning controls what types of development are allowed in specific areas, and the team reviews applications for rezoning, minor variances and special permits.

rows.title: Building permits

rows.a: The City of Oklahoma City's Development Services issues building permits, required to construct, alter, repair, enlarge, move or demolish any primary or accessory structure. Residential permits are applied for online or at the Business Center at 420 W. Main St.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Oklahoma City, Subdivision & Zoning
rows.line: Zoning sets how land may be used and the development standards for all property in the city; the Planning Commission recommends zoning changes and the City Council approves them.

rows.a: Oklahoma City's zoning sets how land may be used and the development standards for all property in the city. The Planning Commission makes recommendations on zoning changes, and the City Council has final approval.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Gresham, Building Permits and Inspections
rows.line: Needed to build, enlarge, alter, repair or move a building or change its electrical, gas, mechanical or plumbing systems; services are at City Hall, and permit and land use records can be looked up.

rows.a: The City of Gresham issues building permits for building, enlarging, altering, repairing or moving a building and for its electrical, gas, mechanical and plumbing systems. Permit services are at Gresham City Hall, and permit and land use records can be looked up online.

rows.office: City of Gresham Urban Design and Planning, Planner on Duty
rows.line: The interactive zoning map shows zoning designations and earlier permits; the Planner on Duty answers site-specific questions by email, phone or at City Hall.

rows.a: The City of Gresham's interactive zoning map shows a property's zoning designation and earlier permits, and the Planner on Duty answers site-specific planning questions by email, by phone or at City Hall.

rows.title: Building permits

rows.a: Portland Permitting & Development's Zoning and Land Use pages hold the city's zoning code, its zoning maps and answers to common zoning questions.

rows.a: The City of Pittsburgh's Department of Permits, Licenses, and Inspections issues building permits, with a separate permit for each type of work and each system, such as building, demolition, electrical and mechanical. Its page also lists work that needs no permit.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Pittsburgh Department of City Planning, Zoning & Development Review
rows.line: Administers the City's Zoning Code and is the first stop for most construction permits; it reviews renovations, additions and new construction and keeps the zoning map.

rows.a: The Zoning & Development Review Division of Pittsburgh's Department of City Planning administers the City's Zoning Code and is the first stop for most construction permits, reviewing renovations, additions and new construction. Its page links the zoning map and the code.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Reading, Building and Trades Codes Enforcement
rows.line: Issues permits for new construction, alterations, renovations and repairs in the building, electrical, mechanical and plumbing trades, reviews plans and inspects the work.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Reading?
rows.a: The City of Reading's Building and Trades division issues permits for new construction, alterations, renovations and repairs, reviews building plans and inspects construction in the city, under Pennsylvania's Uniform Construction Code.

rows.office: City of Reading, Zoning and Planning
rows.line: Interprets and enforces the Zoning Ordinance; a zoning permit is needed before building, moving or expanding a structure, and its zoning map shows each area's classification.

rows.a: The City of Reading's Zoning and Planning office interprets and enforces the Zoning Ordinance and keeps the zoning map. A zoning permit is needed before building, moving or expanding a structure.

rows.title: Building permits

rows.line: Reviews plans and inspects construction under the adopted building codes for residential and commercial structures; building permits are applied for, fees paid, status checked and inspections scheduled in the Citizen Self Service Portal.

rows.line: Reviews zoning, subdivision and permit applications; the Unified Land Development Code, newly adopted in 2025, is the city's official zoning and subdivision regulation, and the page links the City's interactive GIS map.
rows.q: Where is Baytown's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Baytown's Planning Division reviews zoning, subdivision and permit applications. The city's official zoning and subdivision regulations are in its Unified Land Development Code, newly adopted in 2025, and its page links the City's interactive GIS map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Dallas Planning & Development, Permitting & Inspections
rows.line: The city's building permits and inspections, with its forms, fees and certificates of occupancy.

rows.a: The City of Dallas's interactive zoning map shows the zoning of each property in the city. The city notes the map is not data certified by a land surveyor.

rows.a: Every property in the City of Denton has a zoning designation that regulates its uses, and the Denton Development Code sets the design standards for new development. A zoning change takes a public hearing before the City Council; the page links the City's zoning map.

rows.title: Building permits

rows.a: The City of DeSoto's Building Inspection Division handles plan review, permit issuance, public consultation and on-site inspections to verify compliance with the adopted codes, and processes Certificate of Occupancy applications. rows.title: Zoning

rows.a: The City of DeSoto's Planning & Zoning division administers and interprets the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance and maintains and updates the official Zoning Ordinance and Zoning Maps. rows.title: Building permits

rows.line: Administers the city's building and zoning ordinances through site plan review, permits and inspections; permits are applied for online through the Citizen Self Service Portal, and the City adopted the 2024 International Codes beginning October 1, 2025.

rows.a: The City of Farmers Branch's Building Inspection Division administers the city's building and zoning ordinances, coordinating site plan review, permits and inspections. rows.line: The Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance applies to the use and development of all land in the City, with setbacks, lot size, building height and site standards; the City's online map gives a property's zoning classification.

rows.a: In Farmers Branch, the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance applies to the use and development of all land within the City, including dimensional standards such as setbacks, lot size and building height. The City's interactive online map gives a property's zoning classification.

rows.a: The City of Mesquite's Building Inspection Division reviews plans, issues construction permits and inspects new and remodel work, residential and commercial. rows.a: The City of Sugar Land issues building permits and schedules inspections. Permit applications submitted on or after January 21, 2026 must meet the 2024 International Code Council codes the City adopted.

rows.a: The City of Tacoma's Planning and Development Services issues building permits in the city. Its Tacoma Permits site submits and searches permits online.

rows.a: Tacoma's zoning is set in Chapter 13.06 of the Tacoma Municipal Code. The city's interactive map, tMap, shows a property's zoning district by address or parcel number.

rows.a: The City of Vancouver issues building permits for homes inside the city: building, adding to, altering, repairing or demolishing one. Its residential building permits page explains them and links to its online permit center.

rows.q: Where is Vancouver's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Vancouver's planning, development and zoning pages hold its zoning. Its updated Comprehensive Plan, zoning map and zoning code took effect on July 31, 2026.

rows.a: The City of Fitchburg's Planning and Zoning Department reviews all development proposals and administers the City's zoning, land division and other land regulation ordinances. It also updates and administers the Comprehensive Plan.

rows.a: The City of Madison's Development Services Center issues building permits. Its chart says, project by project, whether a permit is needed and whether to contact Zoning, Building Inspection or Fire; an address's permit record is requested through the City's public records request center.

rows.a: The City of Madison's Building Inspection division administers the Zoning Code; each district sets how a property can be used, its building setbacks and its required parking. The page links the zoning map and code, and the Zoning Counter meets by appointment.

rows.title: Zoning

rows.q: Where is Sun Prairie's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Sun Prairie's Planning Department oversees most development applications filed with the city. Its Zoning and Development page links the Sun Prairie Zoning Interactive GIS Map and the zoning application forms, including variances and zoning map amendments.

rows.line: Issues permits and inspects construction for compliance with minimum life and health safety standards; its frequently asked questions include whether a re-roof, new siding, a shed, a fence or a kitchen remodel needs a permit.

rows.a: The City of Wauwatosa's Building and Safety division issues permits and inspects construction for compliance with minimum standards for life and health safety. rows.a: The City of Wauwatosa's Planning and Zoning Division manages the Zoning Code and processes zoning permits and Board of Zoning Appeals applications. rows.q: Where is West Allis's zoning?
rows.a: West Allis's zoning code determines what can be built where, and the City's Planning and Zoning page points to the code and the zoning map online. rows.title: Building permits

rows.a: The City of Stockton's Building & Life Safety division takes and issues permit applications for work within city limits, reviews the plans and inspects the work on site.

rows.a: The City of Stockton's Zoning Map divides the city into zones that set what land can be used for and standards such as height, lot coverage, parking and setbacks. A rezoning takes a Planning Application and public hearings before the Planning Commission and the City Council.

rows.title: Building permits

rows.line: Needed to build, enlarge, alter, repair, move or demolish a building, or to change its electrical, gas, mechanical or plumbing systems, unless the California Building Code exempts the work.

rows.a: The City of Santa Rosa issues building permits for work on buildings and their electrical, gas, mechanical and plumbing systems in the city, unless the California Building Code exempts the work. Meetings with a permit technician are by appointment.

rows.a: The City of Boulder issues building permits; building, altering, enlarging, repairing or removing any building or structure takes one. Applications go in through the city's Customer Self-Service Portal, and the city's page links a search of previous permits and property information.

rows.a: The City of San Bernardino's Building and Safety Division issues building permits and inspects new and remodeled buildings on private property. rows.a: The City of Fontana's Planning Department processes land use applications and reviews every new development, and every modification or upgrade of an existing structure, against the Development Code, any applicable specific or community plan and the General Plan before construction begins. rows.a: The City of Torrance's Planning Division reviews development plans for conformance with land use policies and standards, processes development applications and responds to inquiries on zoning and land use. It also maintains the City's General Plan.

It processes zone changes, conditional use permits, variances and zoning ordinance amendments, and administrative applications such as site plan reviews and fence permits, and its page links the Online Zoning Map and the Zoning Map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Huntington Park Community Development, Building & Safety Division
rows.line: Building plans and permits are required for most residential, commercial and industrial construction on private property; the page lists the work that needs a permit, from room additions, roofing and window replacements to electrical, mechanical, plumbing and solar.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Huntington Park?
rows.a: The City of Huntington Park's Building & Safety Division requires building plans and permits for most residential, commercial and industrial construction work on private property, whether new, added, remodeled or altered. Permits are required for work such as new structures and room additions, roofing, structural repairs, pools and spas and window replacements, and for electrical, mechanical, plumbing, solar and electric vehicle charger work.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Huntington Park Community Development, Planning & Zoning Division
rows.line: Zoning sets the rules for land use, building design and development standards and helps implement the General Plan; the page links the Zoning Code and the Zoning Map (adopted November 7, 2023).
rows.q: Where is Huntington Park's zoning?
rows.a: Huntington Park's zoning sets rules for land use, building design and development standards, helping implement the City's General Plan. The Planning & Zoning Division's Zoning Resources page links the Zoning Code, the Zoning Map (adopted November 7, 2023) and the HP Downtown Specific Plan.
